notes: SEED METADATA WAS WRONG: seed gave Sensors 21(21):7261, DOI 10.3390/s21217261 -- the CORRECT canonical publication is Sensors 2021, 21(23):7853, DOI 10.3390/s21237853 (published 25 Nov 2021), verified via PMC (PMC8659926), the paper's own self-citation on page 1, and DOI resolution to mdpi.com/1424-8220/21/23/7853. Dataset (HARTH = Human Activity Recognition Trondheim): 22 participants, each wore TWO Axivity AX3 3-axial accelerometers (right front thigh + lower back) for ~2 hours in free-living conditions. Sampling rate 50 Hz. Ground-truth labels annotated frame-by-frame from a chest-mounted camera; high inter-rater agreement (Fleiss' Kappa = 0.96). 12 annotated activity classes (walking, running, shuffling, stairs ascending/descending, standing, sitting, lying, cycling sit/stand, etc.). Official code + baseline ML models: https://github.com/ntnu-ai-lab/harth-ml-experiments . UCI mirror: dataset/779 (harth.zip ~296 MB). PDF downloaded from Europe PMC render of PMC8659926 (MDPI direct PDF was bot-blocked / Access Denied); verified as valid 19-page PDF, 4,401,722 bytes, first page title 'HARTH: A Human Activity Recognition Dataset for Machine Learning'.
